verdict.rationale: For a framework, the official SDK surface is its own first-party packages and tooling. Angular documents first-party modules for forms, routing and more [angular-docs-3], a broad suite of tools, APIs and libraries [angular-docs-31], and an official installable CLI (@angular/cli) [angular-gh-5, angular-docs-9, angular-docs-16]. However, nothing in the evidence frames these as SDKs aimed at AI-native or agentic use, and only TypeScript/JavaScript is covered [angular-gh-1]. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation or reference for programmatic/agentic consumption, multi-language SDK coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs in AI-native workflows.
